name: Vicarious Trauma
body:
School necromancy; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 2, lathspell 2, psychic 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (an iron ring)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a vile connection between you and another creature that transfers some of your wounds to them.

You take a -1 penalty to AC and saving throws, but you take only half damage from all wounds and attacks that deal hit point damage. The amount of damage not taken by you is transferred to the targeted creature.

Other detrimental effects that do not cause hit point damage are not shared, including lowered total HP due to changes in their Constitution modifier.
